description: This file contains end-to-end tests for the shared session reuse feature in the litellm project. It verifies that the shared_session parameter is properly handled and passed through various functions and classes to ensure connection pooling and performance improvements.

methods.name: bool is_parameter_active_in_source(source_code: str, search_pattern: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific parameter or pattern exists in source code and is not commented out.

methods.name: test_acompletion_accepts_shared_session()
methods.description: Verifies that the acompletion() function has a shared_session parameter, which defaults to None.

methods.name: test_completion_accepts_shared_session()
methods.description: Verifies that the completion() function has a shared_session parameter, which defaults to None.

methods.name: test_acompletion_passes_session_to_completion()
methods.description: Checks that acompletion() includes shared_session in the kwargs passed to completion() by inspecting source code.

methods.name: test_handler_completion_accepts_shared_session()
methods.description: Verifies that BaseLLMHTTPHandler.completion() accepts the shared_session parameter.

methods.name: test_handler_async_completion_accepts_shared_session()
methods.description: Verifies that BaseLLMHTTPHandler.async_completion() accepts the shared_session parameter.

methods.name: test_handler_passes_session_to_async_completion()
methods.description: Ensures that the shared_session parameter is passed from completion() to async_completion(), crucial for connection reuse.
